notes.title: Hotfix v.9985
notes.content:
Hello everyone, friends!	
	
We have a small hotfix before the major upcoming update 	)
	
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457555/e1e0a96e176a751d8094469b87238eaa9dcdb4cd.jpg	
	
ARENA:	
	
	
 Repeat battles in the Arena are now available every new day	
 The camera is much smoother and no longer clips through walls and floors	
 You can now zoom in/out the camera	
 Character selection now works perfectly and instantly, without delay	
 Damage numbers are larger	
 You can now see who is on which team (toggle with the H key)	
 Healing abilities of Monika and Aela have been reduced	
 Battle sounds have been added	
 Battle music has been added	
	
	
HEALING:	
	
	
 You can no longer heal clients multiple times a day	
	
	
LOCATIONS:	
	
	
 The portal to the Underground Shelter now works correctly	
 The portal in the Mystic Forest is now better and more convenient to use	
 Food is no longer consumed during trips (the coachman takes care of you 	) )
	
	
SOUNDS AND MUSIC:	
	
	
 Some sound issues in the Mystic Forest have been fixed	
	
	
WORLD:	
	
	
 Icons for ""Dream House"" and the rented house in the capital have been added	
 Icons for traders and the guide have been added	
	
	
BUGS AND ERRORS:	
	
	
 Misa no longer remains after defeating SPOILER	
 The puzzle error on monitors with resolutions below 1920x1080 has been fixed

notes.title: Healer Simulator RPG has finally launched in Early Access!
notes.content:
It has happened!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457555/3b88ca739e3a5a8da368c9d89ee6df167abdea29.png
The breathtaking, magnificent, and mesmerizing Healer Simulator RPG is finally out!

An adventure spanning 10 in-game days awaits you (you can continue beyond that, but the main story is currently designed for 10 days).

What will you see in the full game that wasn’t in the demo?


- New healing, environmental, and creature effects and sounds.
- New healing mechanics: the second tier of healing power unlocks even more possibilities for you!
- The ability to rent a new healing space and unleash your full potential in a large city (the Capital).
- A mysterious, mystical forest and journeys with unique characters!
- An arena showcasing the best warriors and mages who have visited the Capital. Place your bets and either profit or lose it all (the choice is yours!).
- Incredible events that may (or may not) happen in the Capital!

If you haven’t played the demo, even more thrills await you from the very first glance!

Want to know what’s coming next? Follow us on social media.

And it only gets more interesting from here!

Sincerely,
Valsi Noen Games

notes.title: Release date delay
notes.content:
Postponement of Healer Simulator RPG Release: Why We Decided to Wait?

Welcome to our players and everyone following the development of Healer Simulator RPG!

Today, we want to honestly explain why we made the difficult decision to postpone the game's release. It wasn't an easy choice, but we are confident: this will make the game significantly better!

We would like to apologize for the postponement and then explain why it is necessary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457555/1b812daff59ae503b6953739ebf81586ff9a8fbd.jpg

1. Improving Gameplay Based on Tester Feedback

Since the announcement, we have received feedback from participants who played the DEMO version of the game (by the way, it’s still available). Many players noted that the healing and patient interaction mechanics can be made deeper and more realistic, and the boss difficulty can be adjusted to create a more challenging and flexible combat system (but not overdo it and make it too difficult like for Dark Souls fans).

«We realized that we can add more variety to diagnosis and treatment so that each disease has its own unique features and is reflected in a more interesting and creative way» – says the lead game designer of the project.

Instead of releasing a “raw” version, we are adding new mechanics, such as:

Arena (You will be able to watch battles between various game characters, including key characters! And, of course, place bets, winning or losing gold).
Dungeons and... Dragons, yes (The dungeon system includes random enemies, various traps, and randomly generated rooms to make each adventure unique! Moreover, you decide whether to go with one group or another into the dungeon, making it even more exciting and unpredictable).
Improved Patient AI (they will behave more realistically).
Enhanced Visuals (we will showcase a new trailer with more vibrant graphics, allowing you to immerse yourself in an even more beautiful universe of Healer Simulator RPG and experience greater bliss by diving even deeper!)
More Bosses! (of course, some bosses were hidden in the Demo version, but we decided to add even more to implement the new combat system we mentioned earlier).
2. Qualitative Changes, Not Just Bug Fixes

The postponement is not just about “finishing what we didn’t have time for.” We want the game to make a strong impression right away. Therefore, we are working on:

Revamped Graphics (improved shaders, animations, interface).
Optimization (so the game runs smoothly even on low-end PCs).
Additional Content (new locations, quests, characters).
As one of our developers said:

«If we released the game now, it would be a good project. But we want it to be excellent».

3. Community Feedback – Our Main Guide

We have carefully studied the feedback on various social platforms and social networks.

We listen to everyone’s opinion! This is important to us, please share your ideas, express your thoughts in any way and wherever you feel comfortable!

4. Experience of Other Developers: Why Postponement is Okay?

We studied the stories of other studios and realized: postponement is often the best decision.

We love to learn. We believe this is important. We are not ashamed to admit our mistakes if we learn from them. We also learn from others’ mistakes or life paths.

There have been many amazing projects that postponed their release date for various reasons, and afterward, this patience and hard work fully paid off with satisfied users and positive reviews. We want our game to turn out excellent as well, so we are ready to work on it even more and harder!

5. What Does This Mean for Healer Simulator RPG?

We don’t want to repeat the mistakes of those who [strike]rushed for the sake of a date[/strike]. Our goal is a game that we will be proud of, and you will enjoy for many years.

So, When is the Release?

Release Date: May 13, 2025.

Thank you for your understanding and support! We promise that the wait will be worth it.  

P.S. Want to know more?

Subscribe to our social networks – we will soon announce a new trailer and showcase the part of the work we talked about in this news!
